newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 6.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Securities trading turnover on the Shanghai Stock Exchange hit a record high of 1,237.5 billion yuan in the first four months of 1997.
- Huangshan Tourism Development Co Ltd will list 40 million A shares on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
- Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products Co Ltd will issue an additional 100 million B shares with China Southern Securities Co being the lead underwriter.

- BUSINESS NEWS - Zhou Daojiong, chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, said China's experiments with listing companies overseas had been successful and Hong Kong will continue to be the main market for foreign listings of domestic firms.
